Wide eye-level 28mm lens, 16:9 composition. Scarlett (Image 1) stands at the near curb of a broad downtown crosswalk, one foot poised over the first white stripe, weight shifted forward, eyes fixed toward the far sidewalk, relaxed purpose held just before movement. Commuters cluster around her and stream in opposing lanes, with delivery cyclists threading between them; yellow taxis wait and begin rolling behind the crossing, framed by mirrored glass-and-steel office towers. Bright late-morning daylight creates crisp reflections on windows and vehicles with soft ambient fill in the street canyon. Clean daylight film stock, airy neutral palette, subtle warmth, vivid coral accent, modern social-first editorial energy.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
